result.title: GCSR-OCC: Geometry Calibration and Semantic Routing for Open-Vocabulary Occupancy Prediction
result.summary: Open-vocabulary 3D occupancy prediction represents scene geometry and semantics in a unified voxel grid, enabling recognition beyond predefined categories. One approach reconstructs scenes with 3D Gaussians and converts them into voxel occupancy. However, Gaussian scale inflation and excessive overlap can distort voxel occupancy predictions, while semantic mixing can arise within Gaussians spanning multiple categories and during 3D--2D semantic feature alignment. We propose GCSR-OCC, which combines geometry calibration and multi-mode query-conditioned semantic routing for indoor occupancy prediction from a single RGB image. The Evidence-Conserving Gaussian-to-Occupancy operator (EC-G2O) uses kernel mass normalization, $p$-norm aggregation, and a learnable gain to suppress scale inflation and excessive local evidence accumulation while calibrating occupancy responses. Multi-mode Query-First Gaussian Semantic Routing (MM-QGSR) matches multiple semantic modes per Gaussian to text queries and aggregates query-specific evidence into voxels through a learnable text-conditioned router. Fine-grained subclass queries and smoothed semantic aggregation further refine voxel-level predictions. Without 3D semantic annotations, GCSR-OCC achieves state-of-the-art performance in open-vocabulary occupancy prediction on Occ-ScanNet, with 63.31% geometric IoU and 27.44% semantic mIoU. It also reduces geometric aggregation latency from 19.76 ms to 12.88 ms. Our code will be made publicly available.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 GCSR-OCC，从单张 RGB 图像做开放词汇室内 3D 占据预测：用核质量归一化、p-norm 聚合与可学习增益校准 Gaussian-to-Occupancy 的占用响应，并以多模式、文本查询条件的路由把语义证据聚合到体素，在 Occ-ScanNet 上无需 3D 语义标注即取得较好几何与语义指标。
AI.relevance_reason: 「每个 Gaussian 保留多个语义模式 + 可学习查询路由聚合证据」的结构可能为 LVR 中多假设 latent 状态与任务相关视觉证据筛选提供方法线索，但任务是 3D 占据重建、无推理轨迹，可迁移性需核查。
